item.title: Nozawana Pickles: Nagano's Signature Pickled Greens — Guide
item.description: Nozawana are the long leafy greens of a local turnip variety originally from the Nozawa Onsen area, traditionally salt-pickled in large batches after the autumn harvest to preserve them through the long mountain winter, resulting in one of Nagano’s most characteristic tsukemono (pickles). The pickled greens have a savoury, gently tangy flavour and are eaten on their own, chopped over rice, wrapped around rice, or used as a filling for oyaki dumplings, appearing on tables and in shops throughout the prefecture as an everyday local staple.
